notes: Summary: Global research org (equities + macro + quant), central portal for analyst notes, proprietary models, and time-series datasets. Looking to replace a brittle Elastic + custom reranker stack.
Scale: target index ~200M chunked docs (policy pages, research notes, SEC filings excerpts). Estimated vector count after chunking ~250M.

Traffic/SLAs: daytime peak ~75 qps across analytics teams, typical 30 qps. Need 95th percentile query latency <200ms for topK (including reranking). Background batch reindex nightly, incremental shards in <2h.
Cost sensitivity: procurement target <= $0.08 per Query (embedding + cross-encoder rerank) at 30 qps sustained. CFO flagged anything > $600k ARR as needing executive review.

Model preferences: embeddings: open / high-quality embedder (sentence-transformer or Redwood-verified embed-v2). Reranker: cross-encoder 3B quant or equivalent; generator models not required for primary search but used for analyst summarization POC.

Routing: want dedicated pools for consistent latency; automatic fallback to smaller quantized model acceptable for non-critical workloads. Multi-region read replicas in EU + NA for residency/performance.
Security: must integrate with corporate KMS (HSM-backed), tenant-level envelope keys, SAML SSO, audit logs forwarded to Splunk; retention controls for research docs per legal's 7-year policy.
Quotes: "We can't tolerate noisy latency — analysts will abandon if answers take >250ms. Also: 'we will not send raw docs out of EU region' (legal)."

POC notes: Redwood dedicated deck reviewed 2026-02-25 (see drive). POC charter: measure end-to-end query latency with reranker on 50M sampled index and calculate cost per query under batching scenarios.
Technical open items: how KV cache handles long tails for time-series tokens, expected GPU utilization at 30 vs 75 qps, recommended quantization profile for cross-encoder rerankers.
Operational: want SLOs, SLA for dedicated pools, and runbook for failover to hosted fallback model in case of capacity constraints.
Internal stakeholders: Head of Research (Elena Markov), Platform Infra (Rajesh Patel), Security (Marta Silva), Procurement (Oliver Kent).
Procurement cadence: procurement RFP closes mid-May, legal + security review through May, executive signoff in June if POC hits latency/cost targets.
